archetype_line.description: What this person's archetype means for THEM, in one or two sentences, naming the measurement that earned it. Never a definition of the archetype in general.

how_you_work.description: Short paragraphs describing the actual shape of their working day: how they open a session, how much rope they give the agent, when they step in, how they verify. Every paragraph cites at least one number from the input.

evidence.description: The numbers behind it, copied from the input.

one_experiment.description: One concrete thing to try in the next session, small enough to do, and tied to a number above so they can tell whether it worked.
